cases.rationale: The crop shows a person at upper left beneath an open black umbrella, rows of individual orange chairs and long wooden slatted bench seating on a passenger boat deck with railing and surrounding water. The tiny dark clipped mark at the upper border could be a bird wing but has inadequate identity detail, so bird is unclear. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; the seating is distinguishable from a couch or dining table, and no other category object is identifiable.

Several actual people stand or skate in a skate park. Visible decks and wheels beneath the left skater, above the central person and beside the airborne skater at right identify skateboards. The ramp and light poles are not furniture, traffic signals or boards of another sporting type. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual woman holds a fork and knife at a dining table bearing two pizzas, a salad bowl, bottles and stemmed drinking glasses. Black individual dining-chair backs are visible, and full-size buses can be identified through the window. The glasses have stems and feet rather than drinking-tumbler form; the woven item at right is a hat, not a handbag. The salad leaves do not identify broccoli. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A sleeping baby lies next to a yellow bear-shaped plush with a rounded muzzle and small dark eyes, wearing a blue hooded outfit. The stuffed bear counts as teddy bear, not an actual bear or another actual animal. Red floral fabric supports the baby, but the tight crop does not establish a bed frame or mattress, so bed is unclear. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no other category identity is unresolved.

A standalone monitor and an open laptop sit on a computer desk. The laptop keyboard is visible, as is a mouse beside the monitor base. A black office chair occupies the lower right, and bound books with visible page/spine structure are stacked at the desk's rear right. The desk is a work desk, not a dining table; the standalone screen counts as tv while the integrated screen belongs to the laptop. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

People surround a produce stall with identifiable red-and-yellow apples and crates of capped drink bottles in the foreground. Some small yellow produce near the rear center could include bananas, and some round yellow/orange fruit lacks sufficient detail to distinguish oranges from the apples, so banana and orange remain unclear. The tall metal dispenser is an urn rather than a bottle; the shopping sacks are not identifiable handbags or backpacks. The selling counter is not a dining table. All 75 frozen definitions were considered.

Two actual people sit at a dining table with individual high-backed chairs. A handled cup and saucer, open floral bowl, stemmed glass and narrow-neck clear bottle/carafe are visible. Roses stand in a white flower vase, and a wall clock hangs in the distant left background. Several small silver utensil-like pieces near the place settings are too indistinct to resolve fork, knife or spoon identity, so those three categories remain unclear. The teapot is not itself a cup or bottle; bread on a plate does not establish a sandwich. All 75 frozen definitions were considered.

An actual woman handles bananas beneath hanging banana bunches. A metal bowl at right holds peeled banana pieces. The foreground glass container has a wide jar mouth rather than bottle form; the red plastic sack is not a handbag, and the selling surface does not identify a dining table. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The tiled bathroom contains a wall-mounted sink with faucet and drain, a cropped actual toilet at right, and a green handled open bowl/dipper on the floor. The much larger blue pail is a bucket rather than a drinking cup or bottle. The green vessel has a bowl body and is not a sink or a small eating spoon. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two people sit against a continuous upholstered couch back with bananas and banana peels on plates in front of them. A clear straight-sided drinking cup stands at lower left. The black looped handheld item on the left person's lap could be scissors, but its blades cannot be resolved, so scissors is unclear. The food rests on a black padded surface whose identity as an actual dining/eating table versus upholstered furniture is unresolved, so dining table is unclear. The straight drinking vessel is not a wine glass. All 75 frozen definitions were considered.

A cropped metal fire hydrant at left has an identifiable hydrant body, capped outlet and chain. Grass and purple flowers grow beside steps without visible pot context, so they do not establish a potted plant. The torn printed material along the curb is not a bound book or a real object depicted on it. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two actual people occupy a low full-size boat near the upper middle, with a long hull supporting their seated bodies on the water. Numerous smaller sailing craft surround them; the boat judgment is supported by the occupied full-size vessel without relying on potentially model-sized sailboats. The mast-and-sail structures do not identify kites or umbrellas, and the craft are not surfboards. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
